scope.en: Source-derived large-bowel educational exterior in its source-consistent intestinal pair. Taenia ribbons are teaching surfaces, not photographic tissue; no continuous-lumen or mixed-source CT registration approval.
scope.zh: 来源大肠的教学外表面，置于同源肠道组合中。结肠带为教学表面，并非照片级组织；未接受连续肠腔或跨来源 CT 配准。

gatePolicy: Existing gallery gates retained verbatim; no new anatomy/runtime/quality gate or count change.

priorReview.visualStatus: passed — educational exterior only, source-consistent pair

priorReview.placementStatus: source-consistent pair only; mixed-source CT registration rejected

failure.en: Near rectangular frame with near-uniform bead-like haustra; pale taenia strips look intermittently detached; cecal bulb and appendix junction remain toy-like.
failure.zh: 原大肠是近矩形框加重复鼓包，纵行条带像浮在表面。

cause.en: Uniform procedural radius modulation and a box-like path replaced region-specific anatomical form.
cause.zh: 用统一半径变化替代不同肠段的真实外形。

change.en: BodyParts3D source exterior replacement; see precise bridge/motion/fragment-cleanup receipt.
change.zh: 采用来源明确的肠段、直肠和阑尾外表面；清除来源网格中小于0.5 mm的离散碎片。

lesson.en: Regional calibre and bends must come from anatomical reference; repeated bumps are not equivalent to haustra.
lesson.zh: 解剖图谱也可能有网格碎片和重复归属；来源可信不能替代质量检查。

limits.en: Closed exterior modeling boundaries, no continuous validated lumen. Taenia ribbons are source-derived teaching surfaces, not photographic tissue finish.
limits.zh: 保留封闭的外表面建模边界，不代表连续且经验证的肠腔。结肠带是来源图谱的教学表面，不是照片级组织材质。
